title: Fourier coefficients of the high-degree part
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, let $d\in\mathbb N$, and let $T\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. The Fourier–Walsh coefficient of the part of $f$ supported on sets of size greater than $d$, at frequency $T$, equals $\widehat f(T)$ if $|T|>d$, and equals $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function f on the n-dimensional cube
Subset T of the n coordinate indices
